next.reason: 1985 defines each PICTURE symbol. §2023:13.18.40.4 GR14 restates them (P counted in digit positions with the same algebraic-value operations a) to d), S, V, X, Z, 9, 0, /, ',', '.', + - CR DB, *, cs), with §2023:13.18.40.3 SR16/SR17 (P placement, P and '.' exclusive), SR18 (S first), SR12 (V once), SR23 (sign symbols exclusive), SR13 and §2023:12.3.7.4 GR14 (DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA exchange), §2023:12.3.7.4 GR13 (currency symbol) and §2023:13.18.52.4 GR4 (S). Two differences: 1985 'A' 'can contain only an alphabetic character', 2023 'A' 'shall contain any character from the computer's alphanumeric character set'; and the maximum digit positions counting 'P' rises from 18 to 31 (§2023:13.18.40.3 SR14).
